notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
The first update for Infinity Attackers is live! Here are the patch notes:

Patch #1

Added controller support

-If you plug in a controller before starting the game, the game will start in "controller mode". You are still able to switch back to mouse & keyboard whenever, but these things will happen in controller mode

--Small crosshair in front of ship instead of the other
--In the tutorial and mod screen, press x to advance. (Trust me it'll work)

-Unfortunately, you cannot switch to controller mode from Mouse/Keyboard mode. You will have to restart the game if you want to switch to a controller mid run.


Added Survival mode

-In this mode, there is no goal to defend. Your objective is simply, SURVIVE.

Other Misc changes

--Decreased cost of spread shot to 25
--Increased cost of Rate of fire upgrade to 15
--Increased "Increase goal HP" & "Increase player HP" cost by 5
--Enemies acquire blasters in wave 3 now instead of wave 6
--Added hit sounds when hitting enemies. 

And that's all! Don't be afraid to let me know if something doesn't work right, i'll be more than happy to fix it! 
As for the next patch, I haven't settled on a release date yet unfortunately. Not only have I been busy with real life stuff, but I plan on starting work on another project which is to be announced!

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm excited to announce that Infinity Attackers is finally ready to go live! I started working on this a year ago, and i'm insanely happy with how it came out. Seeing as this is my first game on Steam and also my first community post, i'll take a second to introduce myself.

My name is Kevin Hale, and I'm the creator and only "employee" of Kevin Hale Games. I also was the sole developer of this game, but I did have some outside help here and there. If you would like to learn more about me and the company, then [url=https://www.kevin-hale.com/projects]click here [/url] and you be taken to the website, where you can learn some more.

Seeing as this is the very first game i've released, I understand if you're a little skeptical and unsure about wanting to buy this game. That's why i not only have a 30% discount (Which is the largest percent Steam would let me take off) i've also got a demo, so you can try the game before you buy it. I would recommend buying it before the discount ends though, because it'll be a while before the next one.

Whether or not you try the game, buy the game, or even show a little bit of interest, I just want to say thank you. My goal with Infinity Attackers, as well as Kevin Hale Games, is to entertain as many people as i can and create something that is fun to play. Be sure to follow the game, because it will be receiving future updates. Also be sure to follow my social media, where i'll announce these future updates.

Now go blast some Drognoks,


Kevin
